training_comparison: Configuration-matched local10k BC; historical dataset bytes and per-batch order were not content-hashed. Public40k is a deployment reference, not a training-matched control.
completion_scope: Only recorded native outcome rows contribute to attempted/success/failure counts. Missing or interrupted rows are unknown outcomes, never physical failures. Incomplete artifacts are retained verbatim; media/input audit availability is reported separately.

verification_scope.initial_state: Partial reset receipt (joint/root/object/palm state), not full simulator or RNG state equivalence.
verification_scope.runtime: Episode receipts bind clean Psi0/SIMPLE commits, native agent, render and task. RRP revision is protocol-declared; full contemporaneous external RRP source bytes were not captured.
verification_scope.model_inputs: Exact fixed image transform and nfe/horizon assertions are bound by frozen runner SHA and boundary tests; hashes record observed model inputs. Raw pre-corruption frames were not retained per inference, so individual mask execution is not independently reconstructed from hashes.

qualification: Report all outcomes and paired counts by config and condition; no checkpoint/condition selection from results. Small development diagnostic, no population superiority claim. Public40k is deployment reference, localBC10k is configuration-matched control (historical data-byte identity unverified).
limitations: Generic grasp task has no validated multi-stage or referential-language judge. Paraphrase robustness is not compositional understanding. RGB mask is image-coordinate fixed, never object-truth-targeted. Ideal proprioception and native tracker unchanged.
